summary: Master the Logical Framework Approach for development projects. Join our comprehensive training to improve your planning, monitoring, and evaluation skills.
lede: The Logical Framework Approach helps development professionals plan interventions by linking problems, objectives, results, and evidence. This course supports project designers, coordinators, and monitoring and evaluation staff in shaping development projects through problem and stakeholder analysis, results chains, Logframe matrices, indicators, assumptions, and risk analysis. It also covers using Logframes in proposals and monitoring, and explaining project logic to funders and teams.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals engaged in the development sector, especially those involved in project design and implementation. Whether you are navigating the complexities of donor expectations or striving to ensure project relevance and impact, this course will provide you with the tools and insights needed to succeed.
audience: NGO program managers and project coordinators
Donor-funded project designers and proposal writers
modules: Foundations of the Logical Framework Approach
LFA in Proposal Development and Donor Requirements
Using LFA in Monitoring and Evaluation
Biases and Pitfalls in Project Design
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management concepts and some experience in project design or implementation. Familiarity with development sector terminology and challenges is recommended.
